scope: Independent fixed idealized geometries illustrating VASPBERRY capabilities; not a reproduction of unpublished author inputs.
dispersion: None; all nuclei and interlayer distances fixed. No interlayer binding or structural stability claim.
geometry_source: Existing public MoS2 intralayer geometry; Nature s41586-026-11069-3 SI Table S2 for 1H/3R distance.

monolayer.registry: One public-example trigonal-prismatic layer, recentered in c=24 A cell

1h-bilayer.registry: Parallel zero-translation Mo-on-Mo/S-on-S; d=6.74 A experimental mean

2h-bilayer.registry: Antiparallel inversion-symmetric 2H; upper Mo over lower S; d=6.17 A comparison geometry

3r-bilayer.registry: Parallel translated by (1/3,1/3); d=6.17 A experimental 3R mean
3r-bilayer.electrostatic_correction: Standard VASP LDIPOL, IDIPOL=3, DIPOL=(0,0,0.5), warm self-consistent restart after preconvergence; same correction retained in fixed-charge stages.
